label: Record all drafts
description: Domain graph behind monitor.recordAll where the entries are kept in a store: every draft recorded, or none. A draft that refuses rolls back the rows recorded before it, so a half-imported file is not a state this tree can be left in. The map still fans out -- the drafts are submitted at once, not one after another -- and on the connection the writes are paced into the one transaction.

nodes.label: Record each draft
nodes.description: monitor.submit once per row; the row's url and method are the submission
